2. Pine Crossing. Source: your own message in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026. The morning receiver's appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift. Hollis said he'd check the shift template.
3. Wichita store (probably Marrow, not confirmed). Source: your message in #central-team on 2 Jul 2025 about an 8am check-in with the "Wichita store dispatcher." It comes right after Tobias says your Zoom is hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours link, but that line doesn't actually name Marrow.

I left out the Tulsa hub from that same 2 Jul 2025 thread because it belongs to Tansley Parcel, not Marrow. Your 9 Jun message mentions three tracker rows marked "waiting," but the channel doesn't say which stores they are.
